title: Merge duplicate records without losing stable order
prompt: Fix `app/records.py` so `merge_records(records)` merges dictionaries with the same string `id`. Preserve first-seen ID order; later records override scalar fields; `tags` are a stable-order union; do not mutate input dictionaries or tag lists. Raise `ValueError` for a record missing a non-empty string id. Edit production code only; do not modify tests. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
